items.title: Bitcoin Miners Are Selling Their Stacks to Fund the AI Boom
items.summary: MARA sold 13,597 BTC after September and Riot sold 20,264 BTC through September to fund debt repayment and AI data center buildouts, as Glassnode flagged the pair as the main sellers among Bitcoin treasury firms.

items.title: Analyst: Bitcoin Below $70,000 is a 'Gift From the Market'
items.summary: K33 Research said bitcoin is in "deep value territory" after a 14% weekly drop, as ETF outflows, liquidations and hedging demand reach levels seen near past bottoms. This post Analyst: Bitcoin Below $70,000 is a 'Gift From the Market' first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: CryptoQuant says bitcoin is back in a bearish phase but has reached a 'value zone'
items.summary: Bitcoin has dipped below its 200-day and 365-day moving averages of $72,900 and $75,900, respectively, CryptoQuant said.

items.title: Ionic Digital (IOND) Sells 737 Bitcoin to Fund Data Center Buildout
items.summary: Ionic Digital sold about 737 bitcoin for roughly $61.6 million after Sept. 30 and plans to use the cash to develop its data center sites, its latest quarterly report shows. This post Ionic Digital (IOND) Sells 737 Bitcoin to Fund Data Center Buildout first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Bitcoin, stocks wobble as Fed's Waller talks of 'shock' 50-point rate hike

items.title: German Court Offers to Drop Movie2k Case for 40,000 Bitcoin
items.summary: A Leipzig judge has offered to dismiss the Movie2k criminal case if the defendant hands over 40,000 bitcoin, which would leave him about 16,000 coins worth roughly $1.02 billion. This post German Court Offers to Drop Movie2k Case for 40,000 Bitcoin first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
